screen: M1 length-weighted named-road version p90 county-held-out residual screen; descriptive-only unless fixed gates pass

method.feature: For each tract, the empirical 90th percentile of named-road segment OSM way versions, weighted by each segment's geometry length clipped to that tract. Each segment's version equals the arithmetic mean of its distinct matching supplied OSM version tokens, matching M1's feature parsing.
method.version_parser: Only supplied Overture roads.sources.record_id values whose source dataset is OpenStreetMap and whose full value matches ^w\d+@(\d+)$ (case-insensitive); no OSM history or external versions.
method.duplicate_tokens: Deduplicate integer versions within each road geometry before averaging; repeated source memberships do not overweight a segment.
method.weighted_quantile: Sort segment-level mean versions ascending and select the first value whose cumulative clipped length is at least 0.90 of total tract named-versioned road length.
method.geometry: Provided road lines and official ACS tract polygons projected to EPSG:5070; intersected segment length is weight; segment portions outside tract excluded.
method.outcome: Frozen cross-fitted S1 Queen/Rook disagreement residual, read from its pinned artifact and not rebuilt or refit.
method.validation: Within each official region, fixed leave-one-five-digit-county-FIPS-out folds; same support and fold definition as the named-road mean screen.
method.correction: OLS intercept and one p90 term; fold-specific mean and population SD estimated only on training tracts; held-out features use those training statistics; zero SD uses scale 1.
method.baseline: Zero correction of the frozen residual on the identical paired support.
method.metric: Pooled and regional county-held-out ΔR²=(baseline SSE - OOF corrected SSE)/baseline SSE; 2,000 paired county-block bootstrap replicates resampled within each region.
method.interpretation_limit: Provided-feature residual association only, not target accuracy, causal evidence, or estimator-promotion evidence.

county_block_bootstrap.resampling: paired held-county baseline/model SSE blocks; counties sampled with replacement within each official region

maricopa-az.feature: length-weighted empirical p90 of per-segment mean unique supplied OSM way versions
maricopa-az.version_parser: OpenStreetMap source record_id fullmatch ^w\d+@(\d+)$, case-insensitive; only supplied record_id values are parsed
maricopa-az.multiple_versions_per_geometry: deduplicate integer way versions and use their arithmetic mean, matching M1 named_mean_version input parsing
maricopa-az.geometry_assignment: transform supplied line geometries and official tract polygons to EPSG:5070; intersect and weight by clipped length
